profile.name: isCAN CAN总线接口适配器
profile.description: isCAN 是一种 CAN 总线接口适配器，用于将计算机连接到 CAN 网络，实现报文收发与总线通信。在实验室中，它常用于嵌入式控制器、工业设备或仪器子系统的联机测试、调试与数据交换。
profile.description_en: The isCAN is a CAN bus interface adapter that connects a computer to a CAN network for message transmission and reception. In laboratory use, it is commonly used for testing, debugging, and data exchange with embedded controllers, industrial equipment, or instrument subsystems that communicate over CAN.
